subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The Big Cypress National Preserve is a protected natural area in Florida.
• It encompasses 729,000 acres.
• It was established to safeguard the habitat of the Florida panther, an endangered species.
• The Big Cypress National Preserve is managed by the National Park Service.
• The National Park Service restricts off-road vehicle use in the area.
prompt: The student wants to indicate the size of the Big Cypress National Preserve. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: A protected natural area, the Big Cypress National Preserve encompasses 729,000 acres of land in Florida.
choices.B: The Big Cypress National Preserve is a natural area in Florida, home to the Florida panther.
choices.C: Home to the Florida panther, Florida's Big Cypress National Preserve is managed by the National Park Service.
choices.D: The Big Cypress National Preserve is a protected natural area managed by the National Park Service, which restricts off-road vehicle use there.

explanation: Choice A is the best answer because it directly accomplishes the stated goal of indicating the preserve's size. By specifying that the Big Cypress National Preserve 'encompasses 729,000 acres,' this choice provides clear quantitative information about the preserve's spatial extent. While the sentence also identifies the preserve as a protected natural area in Florida, the inclusion of the acreage measurement is what makes it effective for the rhetorical purpose specified in the question.
